coverage_decisions.decision: Reviewed all PMT summary pages and eight SR Atomic Structure pages against 4.4. Added activity/count-rate/dose comparison, unequal-duration counting, half-life choice and correct radiotherapy terminology. Existing nuclear equations, half-life curve and fission/fusion diagram retained. Rejected PMT beta stopped by paper, radiotherapy called chemotherapy, absolute short-life safety, and smoke-detector source dispersed into surrounding air. Did not import SR all isotopes unstable or all instability caused by excess neutrons; avoided outdated current fusion-record claims.
